title: Length of Service and the Reconnection Payment — Electric Service Agreement Quick Reference
content:
**Electric Service Agreement — reconnection payment, length of service.**

The basis of the reconnection payment is also multiplied by a tenure share of 0.9 for an agreement in service 120 whole calendar months or more since its start date, 0.95 for one in service at least 60 but fewer than 120 months, and 1 for one in service fewer than 60 months. The tenure share multiplies the basis, taken never below zero, before that amount is rounded to the cent.

| Whole calendar months in service, from the agreement's start date to the payment | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 0.9 |
| 60 to 119 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 60 | 1 |

**Counting months.** Months in service are whole calendar months from the agreement's start date to the day of the payment; a month that has not been completed is not counted.

**Either side of each threshold (hypothetical).**

- 119 whole months: 0.95. 120 whole months: 0.9.
- 59 whole months: 1. 60 whole months: 0.95.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** An agreement started 10 years and 2 months before the payment has 122 whole months in service; a basis of 380.00 USD becomes 342.00 USD (380.00 times 0.9). Started 5 years before the payment to the day, it has 60 whole months and the basis becomes 361.00 USD (380.00 times 0.95).
